label: SEPARATE_EFFICIENT_2, mover, grounding…: Efficient preserves CausesAsCaused. motion uses…
term: separate efficient, mover, grounding, explanatory and mereological graph adapters
definition: efficient preserves CausesAsCaused. motion uses MoverMovedByAnotherLink, retaining nonidentity and respect witnesses. grounding uses ParticipationGrounding.Explanation.Grounds between tagged facts, not implication. ExplanatoryDependence augments the PSR Model with a separate requires relation from reasons to existence facts; explanation p q holds when an admitted reason for q requires p. The rank premise must hold for every such reason and requirement. parthood uses strict order of an explicitly supplied PartialOrder; a graph source is an atom only relative to that chosen proper-parthood interpretation.
note: Analyst adapters, not new historical claims or completion of the strict-ground calculus in issue 348. PSR explains is heterogeneous; its projection does not by itself establish any regress prohibition. Strict parthood assumes no fusion or supplementation. Existing source and typed vocabulary retain their own meanings. Exact Lean locators are TruthCore.Logic.RegressDomains.efficient, .motion, .grounding, .explanation and .parthood; .ExplanatoryDependence supplies model/requires for the fourth adapter. There is no single adapter definition whose body identifies these distinct relations, so this vocabulary-family record does not substitute one arbitrary member as its sole lean_declaration. The five constructors retain their supplied relation inputs and distinct meanings; their philosophical applications remain OPEN.
